title: CompilerKV: Risk-Adaptive KV Compression via Offline Experience Compilation
abstract: arXiv:2602.08686v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prefill-only KV compression freezes a token subset at the end of prefill and decodes from it without further eviction. The retention decision is therefore irreversible, yet existing methods estimate the corrective signals it relies on, per-head reliability and prompt-level compression sensitivity, online from a single noisy prompt. We argue this is the wrong statistical unit: these signals exhibit far higher cross-prompt regularity than within-prompt signal-to-noise. We introduce \textsc{CompilerKV}, a KV-retention policy whose corrective tables are compiled offline from a calibration corpus, reducing online correction after the standard observation-window scan to $O(1)$ lookups plus a budget clamp. We find that compiled retention tables behave as portable architectural priors: rankings transfer across disjoint corpora on four backbones (mean Spearman $\bar\rho{=}0.90$), and direct model-to-model table transfer costs only $0.4$

translated_title: CompilerKV：通过离线经验编译实现风险自适应的KV压缩
translated_abstract: 仅预填充的KV压缩在预填充结束时冻结一个token子集，并从中进行解码，不再进行后续淘汰。因此保留决策是不可逆的，然而现有方法是在线地从单个带噪声的提示中估计其所依赖的校正信号，即每个注意力头的可靠性和提示级别的压缩敏感度。我们认为这是错误的统计单位：这些信号在跨提示之间表现出的规律性远高于提示内的信噪比。我们提出了CompilerKV，这是一种KV保留策略，其校正表是从校准语料库中离线编译得到的，将标准观察窗口扫描之后的在线校正简化为O(1)次查找加上一个预算钳制。我们发现编译得到的保留表表现得如同可移植的架构先验：在四个骨干网络上，排序可以在互不相交的语料库之间迁移（平均Spearman相关系数ρ̄=0.90），且直接的模型到模型表迁移仅需0.4
tldr: 论文提出CompilerKV，通过从校准语料库离线编译KV保留校正表，将在线校正开销降至O(1)查找，且编译出的保留表可作为可移植的架构先验，在跨语料库和跨模型迁移中表现出高度一致性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CompilerKV, which compiles KV-retention correction tables offline from a calibration corpus, reducing online correction to O(1) lookups, with compiled tables acting as portable architectural priors that transfer effectively across disjoint corpora and different models.
